question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
-- Full query with all years
WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
top_driver AS (
    SELECT lr.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points, ds.position
    FROM last_race lr
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    WHERE ds.position = 1
),
top_constructor AS (
    SELECT lr.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points, cs.position
    FROM last_race lr
    JOIN constructor_standings cs ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    WHERE cs.position = 1
)
SELECT td.year,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname as driver_name,
       td.points as driver_points,
       c.name as constructor_name,
       tc.points as constructor_points
FROM top_driver td
LEFT JOIN top_constructor tc ON td.year = tc.year
JOIN drivers d ON td.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON tc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY td.year

WITH last_race AS (

    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),

    SELECT lr.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points, ds.position
    FROM last_race lr

    SELECT lr.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points, cs.position
    FROM last_race lr
    JOIN constructor_standings cs ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    WHERE cs.position = 1
)
SELECT td.year,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname as driver_name,
       td.points as driver_points,
       c.name as constructor_name,
       tc.points as constructor_points
FROM top_driver td
